sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS e, AVG((CAST("budget"."Invested" AS REAL) / "budget"."Budgeted")) AS m1 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."School_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.amount invested relative to amount budgeted
why: amount invested / amount budgeted: a ratio of two quantities in USD
average of amount invested relative to amount budgeted per School (by School_id)
gap to the all average of average of amount invested relative to amount budgeted (all level)
gap to the all average of average of amount invested relative to amount budgeted (all level)

why: total of amount invested per School (by School_id) (additive)
share of the all total of total of amount invested (all level)
gap to the all average of total of amount invested: share of the all total (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "School"."County" AS g, AVG(("budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_invested")) AS m1 FROM "budget" JOIN "School" ON "School"."School_id" = "budget"."School_id" GROUP BY "School"."County"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m1" > "s2"."v"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3") SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v"
